profile: A weary man confessing, low and close
persona: A weary man confessing, low and close

lines.text: When I was nine, I took a stone from this mountain.
They said the mountain would want it back.
For thirty years, it rained ash on our town.
So I am giving it back.
It was never the mountain's anger.
It was mine. And I could put it down.

omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
